plugins.prepareCmd: V='${nextRelease.version}'; sed -i -E 's/(s\.version[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*")[^"]*/\1'"$V"'/' Airwallex.podspec; sed -i -E 's/(AIRWALLEX_VERSION \(@")[^"]*/\1'"$V"'/' Airwallex/AirwallexCore/Sources/AWXConstants.h; sed -i -E 's/(AIRWALLEX_VERSION[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*).*/\1'"$V"'/' Airwallex/Airwallex.xcconfig; for f in README.md README_zh_CN.md; do sed -i -E "s@(pod 'Airwallex', '~> )[^']*@\1$V@g" "$f"; sed -i -E "s@(github\.io/airwallex-payment-ios/)[^/]*/@\1$V/@g" "$f"; done
